causal.assumptions_right: The receive was held while the path eased, which is what the kill condition required.
causal.assumptions_wrong_or_underweighted: A path invalidation and a level invalidation were not kept as different rules, which later mattered for the March SOFR receive stopped at 4.42.
causal.causal_divergence: The strip paid because the kill stayed quiet and the path repriced lower, not because the entry level itself was a stop.
causal.future_implication: Exit a level stop when the frozen implied rate is through the level, and do not use that rule to close a path trade whose kill has not printed.
causal.observed_reality: The strip was exited near 3.1 on Nov 23, and December CORRA now implies 2.68. The written path kill did not print.
causal.original_belief: A CORRA 2027 strip receive near a 3.4 implied rate would pay if the Bank of Canada did not deliver a mid-3s path and jobs did not stop contracting while trim stayed near 2 percent.
causal.same_information_counterfactual: With the same information, keep the path receive through the repricing and do not close it on a level rule that was not the kill.

items.expression_assessment: The strip, rather than a single meeting contract, expressed the 2027 path that later priced down toward 2.68.

facts.invalidation: BoC delivers or signals the priced 2027 mid-3s path, or trim/median leave ~2% while jobs stop contracting.

items.future_rule: When the kill is a policy path or a labor-and-inflation reversal, absence of that evidence leaves the receive intact. When the kill is an implied-rate level, exit once the frozen implied rate is through that level.
items.lesson: A path invalidation and a level invalidation are different rules. Absence of the path kill leaves the receive intact through the repricing.
items.sizing_assessment: Size was not the error. The process question is which invalidation belongs to which ticket.
items.thesis_assessment: The receive worked because the priced path eased and the written kill, a mid-3s Bank of Canada path or jobs stopping their contraction while trim stayed near 2 percent, did not arrive.
items.timing_assessment: The gain was taken on Nov 23 after about two months while the path invalidation had not printed.
items.what_failed: The kill condition on that strip was a policy path, and it stayed quiet. The later mistake, on a different ticket, was using a level stop and a path stop as if they were the same rule.
items.what_worked: The CORRA 2027 strip was received near a 3.4 implied rate and exited near 3.1 on Nov 23 after about two months. December CORRA now implies 2.68, so the Bank of Canada path did not return to the mid-3s.

causal.assumptions_right: The path test and the level tests were separate rules, and the path test alone was enough to sell the receive. Cash yields kept rallying and SOFR stayed at 3.94, so the two level invalidations stayed unmet.
causal.assumptions_wrong_or_underweighted: The open assumed a confirmed cash-yield rally would pull March implied down from 4.42 toward the fixing. That transmission failed, and the December meeting price moved toward more hikes rather than toward the fixing.
causal.causal_divergence: The cash market delivered the rally the receive wanted, with the two-year and ten-year lower over five days. The futures path went the other way, leaving March implied at 4.525 against the 4.42 stop while December hike pricing firmed.
causal.future_implication: A later March receive is a new open and is not justified by a higher implied rate alone. It needs a fresh case that 4.525 versus cash SOFR 3.94 is underpriced easing, which this packet does not provide while implied remains above 4.42.
causal.observed_reality: The receive was closed on 25 November and the live March implied rate is 4.525, still above 4.42. Cash SOFR is 3.94, the US two-year is 4.61 and the ten-year is 4.85 after further declines, and December prices about 44bp of hikes to 4.31.
causal.original_belief: The March 2027 receive was opened on 23 November to profit if the implied rate fell from 4.42 toward the fixing once the cash-yield rally was confirmed. The written exit was to sell that receive if the implied rate held above 4.42, if SOFR rose toward 4.42, or if US cash yields retraced the prior decline.
causal.same_information_counterfactual: With March implied holding above 4.42, the same information still required the sale of the receive while cash yields were rallying. Keeping the receive because SOFR was 3.94 would have dropped the path rule that was already written.

facts.invalidation: Sell the March 2027 SOFR receive if its implied rate holds above 4.42, if SOFR rises toward 4.42, or if US cash yields retrace the 23 to 27bp decline.

items.no_new_lesson: The close obeyed the precommitted path rule because March implied held above 4.42 and is still 4.525, so the original process remains sound. The cash-yield rally and the 3.94 SOFR fixing were the level tests that stayed unmet, and that cash-market continuation is ordinary variance around a path invalidation that did occur.
items.thesis_assessment: The open thesis required the confirmed cash-yield rally to drag March implied from 4.42 toward the fixing. Cash yields fell further, and the futures path did not follow. The exit matched the separate path rule that a hold above 4.42 sells the receive.
items.what_failed: The receive failed because March implied held above 4.42 and is still 4.525, while December hike pricing firmed to about 44bp and 4.31. The cash-yield rally and the 3.94 SOFR fixing did not pull the futures path down.
